description: Cross-system reconciliation and consistency workflow for B2B telco enterprise sales data across CRM, billing, network inventory, and order management systems.

reconciliation_run_id.description: Unique identifier for a reconciliation run instance.

discrepancy_id.description: Unique identifier for a single discrepancy detected during reconciliation.

external_account_ref.description: Reference to the enterprise account in external systems.

order_id.description: Sales order identifier in the order management system.

service_id.description: Logical service identifier (e.g., MPLS, DIA, SIP trunk) in inventory/billing.

reconciliation_scope.description: Scope definition for what should be reconciled.

time_window.description: Time range of records to reconcile.

functions.name: initiate_reconciliation_run
functions.description: Initialize a new reconciliation run with scope, ruleset, and scheduling options.

requested_by.description: User or system initiating the run.

functions.returns: New reconciliation_run_id and initial run status.

functions.name: get_reconciliation_run_status
functions.description: Retrieve the status, progress, and metrics of a reconciliation run.

log_filter.description: Filter which log entries to include.

functions.returns: Current status, progress percentage, aggregate metrics, and optionally recent logs for the reconciliation run.

functions.name: list_reconciliation_runs
functions.description: List reconciliation runs with filtering and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of reconciliation runs with basic metadata and summary metrics.

functions.name: fetch_source_system_snapshots
functions.description: Fetch and snapshot relevant records from all in-scope systems for a reconciliation run.

systems.description: Systems to fetch data from. If omitted, uses scope.systems from the run.

functions.returns: Snapshot identifiers per system and high-level counts of records fetched.

functions.name: detect_discrepancies
functions.description: Run reconciliation logic on collected snapshots to detect and classify discrepancies.

entity_filters.description: Limit which entity types or accounts to process.

functions.returns: Summary of discrepancies detected, grouped by entity type and severity.

functions.name: list_discrepancies
functions.description: List discrepancies for a reconciliation run with rich filtering and pagination.

include_samples.description: If true, includes a sample of mismatched field values.

functions.returns: Paginated list of discrepancies with key attributes and links to detailed views.

functions.name: get_discrepancy_details
functions.description: Get detailed information about a specific discrepancy, including per-system records.

include_history.description: Include audit trail of actions taken on this discrepancy.

include_raw_payloads.description: Include raw data payloads from source systems.

functions.returns: Complete discrepancy details, including per-system snapshots, mismatch fields, and action history.

functions.name: propose_reconciliation_actions
functions.description: Generate proposed remediation actions for one or more discrepancies based on rules and operator preferences.

discrepancy_ids.description: If omitted, proposals will be generated for all open discrepancies in the run, subject to filters.

action_preferences.description: Preferences controlling which system is considered source of truth and allowed operations.

system_hierarchy.description: Ordered list of systems by trust level (highest first).

auto_resolve_threshold.description: Thresholds below which discrepancies can be auto-resolved.

functions.returns: List of proposed actions per discrepancy, including action types, target systems, and estimated impact.

functions.name: apply_reconciliation_actions
functions.description: Apply one or more reconciliation actions to external systems with transactional grouping and dry-run support.

actions.description: Explicit actions to apply. If omitted, will use latest proposals flagged as auto_executable.

action_id.description: Identifier of the proposed action to apply.

override.description: Optional overrides to the action parameters.

functions.returns: Execution job identifier, per-action result summary, and any failures or partial commits.

functions.name: retry_failed_operations
functions.description: Retry failed reconciliation operations from a previous execution with optional adjustments.

previous_execution_id.description: Identifier of the previous reconcile execution job.

items.description: System-specific error codes allowed for retry.

adjustments.description: Optional adjustments to specific failed operations before retrying.

functions.returns: New execution job identifier and immediate acceptance status for retries.

functions.name: rollback_reconciliation_changes
functions.description: Attempt to rollback changes that were applied to external systems for a reconciliation run or specific discrepancies.

max_age_hours.description: Only rollback operations younger than this age.

reason.description: Reason for rollback for audit logging.

functions.returns: Rollback job identifier, feasibility assessment, and summary of operations targeted for rollback.

functions.name: close_reconciliation_run
functions.description: Formally close a reconciliation run, updating statuses, exporting results, and applying final disposition to discrepancies.

closure_mode.description: Cancel stops processing and marks unresolved discrepancies as ignored or open, depending on policy.

disposition_policy.description: How to treat remaining open discrepancies.

export_options.description: Options for exporting final reconciliation results.

functions.returns: Final run summary, closure status, counts of discrepancies by final disposition, and any export locations.

functions.name: search_reconciliation_runs
functions.description: Faceted search across reconciliation runs with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of reconciliation run summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_reconciliation_runs
functions.description: Create multiple reconciliation runs in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created reconciliation run ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_reconciliation_runs
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many reconciliation runs with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each reconciliation run, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_reconciliation_runs
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many reconciliation runs in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each reconciliation run, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_reconciliation_runs
functions.description: Export reconciliation run datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_reconciliation_runs
functions.description: Bulk-import reconciliation run records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated reconciliation runs.

functions.name: subscribe_to_reconciliation_run_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive reconciliation run lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the reconciliation run.

functions.name: get_reconciliation_run_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a reconciliation run, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the reconciliation run, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_reconciliation_run_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for reconciliation runs using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the reconciliation run action.

functions.name: simulate_reconciliation_run_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a reconciliation run without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the reconciliation run, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_reconciliation_run_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a reconciliation run change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the reconciliation run under change.

functions.name: decide_reconciliation_run_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending reconciliation run approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the reconciliation run.

functions.name: add_reconciliation_run_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a reconciliation run for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the reconciliation run.

functions.name: upload_reconciliation_run_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a reconciliation run with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the reconciliation run.

functions.name: create_reconciliation_run_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a reconciliation run (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the reconciliation run version captured.

functions.name: restore_reconciliation_run_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a reconciliation run from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the reconciliation run.

functions.name: get_reconciliation_run_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for reconciliation runs over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the reconciliation run domain context.

functions.name: get_reconciliation_run_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for reconciliation runs combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the reconciliation run context.

functions.name: create_reconciliation_run_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to reconciliation runs with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current reconciliation runs.

functions.name: evaluate_reconciliation_run_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a reconciliation run in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the reconciliation run.

functions.name: get_reconciliation_run_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a reconciliation run including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the reconciliation run, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_reconciliation_run_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a reconciliation run and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the reconciliation run.

functions.name: assign_reconciliation_run_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a reconciliation run with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the reconciliation run with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_reconciliation_runs
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more reconciliation runs, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each reconciliation run.

functions.name: compare_reconciliation_run_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a reconciliation run with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the reconciliation run, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_reconciliation_run_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to reconciliation run operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of reconciliation run operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_reconciliation_run_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a reconciliation run and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the reconciliation run, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_reconciliation_run
functions.description: Clone a reconciliation run into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned reconciliation run record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_reconciliation_run_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted reconciliation run report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the reconciliation run window covered.

functions.name: escalate_reconciliation_run
functions.description: Escalate a reconciliation run to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the reconciliation run.
